title: Oh wow, this rescue turned to be INTENSE as the dog was fighting for her life!!! #terrier
description:
I had no idea this rescue will turn to be like that... Sunshine was fighting with everything she had!  Between Brenda, Loreta and I, we were able to gain control over this terrier who almost got away!

When we have more Hope For Paws members, we are able to do more rescues.  If you are able to make a small donation today, we would LOVE your support so we can save even more lives: https://www.HopeForPaws.org

If you would like to adopt Sunshine, please visit our friends at Much Love who are currently fostering her and will handle her adoption: https://www.MuchLove.org

Thank you so much for sharing this video with your family and friends  :-)

Eldad
